prompt: Which one is a statistical question?

choices.label: How tall is the Empire State Building?
How tall are 6th graders in our school?

hint: For each choice, ask whether one measurement settles it or whether you need many measurements.

hints.text: For each choice, ask whether one measurement settles it or whether you need many measurements.
The Empire State Building has one height. The school has many 6th graders, and their heights will differ from each other.
The answer is B, "How tall are 6th graders in our school?", since those heights vary.

explanation: A statistical question anticipates a variety of answers instead of one fixed answer.
Choice A asks about one building, which has a single fixed height, so it is not statistical.
Choice B asks about many students whose heights differ, so B is the statistical question.
